Sam K: Heads up — saw steady memory growth on qwen-14b-longseq job when rope-scaling=auto and batching heuristics enabled. Node goes from ~18GB -> ~26GB over ~2h.

Mina R: Do you have the kv-stats dump? Could be micropage interleaving + eviction jitter. :thinking:

Sam K: Pasting kv dump from instance-7 (trimmed):
```
KVPages: total=23456 active=18234 free=5232 micro_pages=6124 reused=2200 frag_ratio=0.18 last_eviction=164s
EvictLog: [slot=1024 len=64 reason=aging] x 42 in 110m
Batcher: avg_window=12ms peak_small_reqs=87
```

Cheng L: Hmm. micro_pages high. My hunch: MQA slab splitting + rope scaling aliasing. When rope_scale != 1.0 we sometimes map KV slots across adjacent page boundaries, which interacts badly with the MQA allocator and causes many small contiguous allocations. Kernel selector may be choosing MQA-optimized kernels that assume different slot layout.

Mina R: We also saw repeated small evictions ~30-60s (thrash). Batching heuristic priming many short requests seems to fill prefixes and then evict quickly. That pattern amplifies fragmentation.

perf-bot: [alert] /telemetry:serving/qwen-14b/instance-7 mem_growth_rate=4MB/min over 120m; trace=tr-8b1f; tag=batcher:profile

Cheng L: Quick repro steps I used: `./serve --model qwen-14b --rope-scale 1.0001 --batcher profile` then `tail -f /var/log/kv_metrics.log`. If rope-scale slightly >1 we start seeing slot aliasing after long contexts (>4096).

Sam K: Tried forcing GQA (disable MQA) and memory growth stops. So MQA slab splitting is a likely culprit. Reuse counters low vs micro_pages high.

Mina R: Suggest two immediate mitigations: 1) force kernel selection to compact kernel for qwen-14b on longcontext workloads; 2) adjust batching heuristic to prefer slightly larger windows for long sessions to reduce short-lived prefix caching.

Cheng L: Profiling output shows kernel switch log: `kernel_select: qwen-mqa-opt -> qwen-mqa-compact at 2026-05-05T10:23:12 when seq_len=2048`. Compact kernel reduces micropage count but increases per-token latency by ~6%.

Sam K: For short-term, that tradeoff is acceptable on Dedicated pools. Long-term we should fix allocator interaction. Proposed fixes: better slot packing in rope-aware allocator + evict debounce to avoid rapid reallocate/evict cycles.

Mina R: Evict debounce idea: if same slab sees >3 evictions within 60s, increase reuse_window for that slab by 2x and pause aggressive prefetch. Should drop thrash.

Cheng L: I'll draft RFC with perf traces and a small repro harness. Also will add a flag `force_rope_scale=1.0` for safer defaults on qwen variants until allocator patch lands.

Sam K: Filing issue INF-3821 and attaching logs + repro. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Mina R: Can someone add the perf traces to the ticket? I captured `perf.data` and kv histograms.

Cheng L: Added perf traces to INF-3821 and pinned the repro command. Next: test allocator patch in canary.
